name: arra-memory-lab
description: A one-click Cloudflare memory-systems lab with D1, Drizzle, Workers AI, Elysia, React, and MCP

scripts.check: npm run version:check && node --test scripts/calver.test.mjs && bun test src/*.test.ts && tsc --noEmit && npm run build

LAB_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Generate a long random owner secret. The browser API sends it as a bearer token; the MCP OAuth approval page accepts it as the owner passphrase. MCP clients receive separate OAuth tokens.

OAUTH_KV.description: OAuth clients, grants, authorization codes, and hashed token state for the remote MCP connector.

DB.description: D1 stores authoritative memories, derived chunks, evidence-backed observations, and bounded metadata-only search traces.

AI.description: Workers AI creates 768-dimensional EmbeddingGemma vectors for optional semantic and hybrid recall.
